reviews.title: Terrible Sportsbook Experience – Would Not Recommend
reviews.text:
My experience with this sportsbook has been absolutely terrible from the start. I deposited $50, and my account was instantly suspended. I had to contact support and join their Discord just to get the issue resolved, which took forever.

Then, when I tried to withdraw my money, the process was ridiculously slow. Another user requested a withdrawal for a MUCH larger amount than mine, after I had already requested mine, and somehow received their money before I even got a proper update.

When I started asking for updates about MY OWN MONEY, instead of giving me answers or providing decent customer service, they called me unprofessional and muted me in their Discord.

It’s ridiculous that a company can take your deposit instantly but make you jump through hoops to access your money. The lack of communication, slow withdrawal process, and disrespectful treatment of customers make this one of the worst experiences I’ve had with a platform.

I would not recommend this sportsbook based on my experience. They seriously need to improve their customer service, communication, and withdrawal process.

reviews.title: No bonus
reviews.text:
I downloaded this app about two weeks ago and deposited $50 to qualify for the advertised bonus. I’ve already played through the money, but I still haven’t received the bonus.

On top of that, I’m unable to add my debit card to withdraw my funds. The only option seems to be submitting a withdrawal request, which is frustrating and inconvenient.

It’s been nearly two weeks, and I still haven’t received my bonus or had a straightforward way to access my money. This experience feels extremely suspicious and misleading. If the app advertises bonuses and accepts deposits, customers should be able to receive the promised rewards and withdraw their available funds without unnecessary delays.

I want a clear explanation of why my bonus hasn’t been credited, why debit card withdrawals are unavailable, and when I can expect this issue to be resolved. I would not recommend this app based on my experience so far. It’s been about 2 to 3 days that it’s depositing and still yet to have my money in my bank account or the Games account. Do not download scam

reviews.title: Unusable
reviews.text:
So odd. I’ve been gambling for years (not proud) but this is the only app that’s ever been so sketch. I signed up today, it right away asked me to verify which I did because I know this is normal. I got the notification my identity was successfully verified and it autofilled my address and my birthday even without me inputting it. So then I go to deposit and 1) it tells me my account isn’t verified? So then I go back and double check to see that it was verified?

But the most sketch is 2) the fact that there isn’t even an option to deposit with a debit card? Bank transfer and crypto are the only ways? I’ve tried prob 10 of these types of prediction and trading apps and this is literally the only one that doesn’t take a card and requires banking access ONLY if not crypto. I figured I’d try a new app with a new user promo but Needless to say, I deleted the app and just placed my World Cup wagers on one of the better known apps.
